name: 90680 · Stanton, CA
findings: ZIP 90680 (Stanton) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90680 (Stanton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90680 (Stanton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
